title: Autonomic Region Reshuffle Readiness Validator and Failover Gate
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: implement an autonomous validator service and failover gate that determines whether a candidate target region (or tier) is sufficiently ready to accept production traffic. This ticket covers the orchestration glue, scoring model, gating thresholds, and a lightweight preflight traffic replay that primes KV caches and validates model-variant fallbacks. The validator will be used by smart routing policies for region selection, tier routing, and automated fallback to compatible model variants during capacity constraints.
plan: 1) Define readiness signals and weightings; 2) Build a validator microservice that aggregates telemetry and runs preflight replays; 3) Integrate with routing controller to enforce hard/soft gates; 4) Add dashboards, alerts, and an escape hatch for manual overrides; 5) Run progressive experiments (shadow cutovers, staged canary) before defaulting routing logic to use the gate. Deliverables include code, runbook, dashboards, and a set of acceptance tests.
technical_design: Readiness score computed as a weighted sum of independent sub-scores: capacity_headroom (0-1), kv_cache_warmth (0-1), variant_compatibility (0-1), sliding_p99_latency (0-1 inverted), replay_success_rate (0-1). Weights: capacity 30%, cache 25%, variant 20%, latency 15%, replay 10% (configurable via feature flag). Validator runs hourly for all candidate regions and on-demand when a region is promoted. Preflight replay will use a bounded synthetic cohort of representative traffic (no PII), replayed through the same routing paths to warm KV caches and exercise model fallbacks. If readiness >= 0.82 -> pass; 0.70-0.82 -> advisory (soft gate with traffic ramp); <0.70 -> fail (route to fallback region/variant). Failover gate enforces both hard (block) and soft (ramp) actions and emits structured events consumed by the routing controller. All scoring decisions are logged to tracer and stored in the readiness index (retention 7d).
tasks: Design readiness signal spec and weight tuning matrix
Implement preflight replay harness with replay throttling and data sanitization
Integrate validator with routing controller and feature-flag rollout
Create Console dashboard: readiness index, sub-score breakdown, recent replays
Write runbook: manual promote/demote, emergency rollback steps, and operator checks
End-to-end tests: synthetic traffic injection, score thresholds, and rollback validation
acceptance_criteria:
- Validator API responds within 250ms for cached assessments and 2s for on-demand replay runs.
- Automatic gating prevents promotion of region when score < 0.70 in 99% of test runs.
- Soft ramp behavior reduces traffic to candidate region by 50% when score between 0.70-0.82 and gradually increases based on continuous scoring.
- Preflight replay warms KV cache to measurable hit-rate improvement (baseline+25%) and identifies failing variant mappings in >90% of injected failure scenarios.
- Dashboard surfaces per-region sub-scores and a time series of readiness for last 7 days.
- Runbook validated in staging with two simulated cutovers without customer-visible errors.
- All decisions are auditable and produce structured events retained for 30 days for post-mortem analysis (indexing pipeline link present).

risks_and_mitigation:
Risk: False positives from replay due to synthetic traffic not matching production distribution. Mitigation: maintain a representative prompt set per customer class and periodically refresh from anonymized production traces.
Risk: Validator becomes single point of failure. Mitigation: validator is stateless and replicated; routing controller falls back to conservative default routing when validator is unreachable.
Risk: Preflight replay generates load spikes. Mitigation: throttle replays, respect region headroom, and run replay during pre-configured low-util windows.
notes_for_reviewers: Focus on scoring weights and the replay cohort selection. We should validate that variant_compatibility logic correctly flags model-variant mismatches (quantization/sequence-length limits). Also confirm audit event format meets compliance requirements for Private deployments.
